# Divider — sukuna-ui

> A thin rule that separates content, horizontally or vertically.

- **Package:** `sukuna-ui` — `bun add sukuna-ui` (or `npm i sukuna-ui`)
- **Import:** `import { Divider } from 'sukuna-ui'`
- **Styles:** `@import "sukuna-ui/theme.css"` (Tailwind v4) or `import "sukuna-ui/styles.css"` (no Tailwind) — see [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/llms.txt)
- **Source:** https://github.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/tree/main/src/components/divider · **Spec:** https://github.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/blob/main/docs/component-divider.md

## Purpose

A thin rule that separates content, horizontally or vertically.

## API

```ts
import type { ComponentPropsWithoutRef } from 'react'

export interface DividerProps extends ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'div'> {
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'   // default 'horizontal'
  decorative?: boolean   // if true: aria-hidden, no separator role
}
```

## Variants & tokens

Base: `border-line`. horizontal → `w-full border-t`; vertical → `h-full self-stretch border-l`.

## States

Static; no interactive states.

## Accessibility

- [ ] Non-decorative dividers expose `role="separator"` + `aria-orientation`.
- [ ] Purely visual dividers set `decorative` so AT ignores them.
- [ ] Line meets ≥ 3:1 against the surface where it conveys structure.
